info.title: VidJutsu Cloud API
info.description: Video editing built for agents: upload takes, edit a timeline with history, and render it on cloud machines. The same operations are MCP tools at https://api.vidjutsu.ai/mcp.

post.description: Turn auto top-up on or off. When usage takes your wallet below `threshold_usd` (default $5), or a render is refused for credits, the card you saved at sign-up is charged `amount_usd` (default $10), at most 5 times a day. A declined card turns it off until you save a card again. `GET /usage` shows the setting. 409 before your first payment.

401.description: No API key or token, or it isn't valid.

409.description: No saved card yet: use POST /billing/checkout first.

default.description: 400 invalid_request (an amount or threshold out of range, or not whole cents)

post.description: Sign up for paid use: a Stripe Checkout link to add a card and make your first payment into your prepaid wallet ($5 by default). There is no monthly fee; usage is paid from the wallet. Open it in a browser. 409 once your wallet is set up: use POST /billing/top-up.

LevelAudio.description: Audio tracks to level, and the loudness to level them to.

author.description: Who is leveling, as Activity shows it.

wallet_after_micros.description: Your balance after it (never below zero).

estimated_vcpu_seconds.description: The box time the job is expected to use, in vCPU-seconds, at $0.03 per vCPU-minute. The charge is the box time it actually uses, by the second, with no minimum.

allowed.description: Whether your wallet would let it start.

reason.description: Why not, when it wouldn't: `no_plan`, `payment_failed`, `spend_limit` or `insufficient_credits`.

Money.description: Money is in micro-dollars (`_micros`, 1,000,000 = $1) with a dollar twin (`_usd`).

selection.description: What is selected, or null to clear it.

playhead.description: Where the playhead is, or null to clear it.

PresenceRequest.description: Fields you leave out stay as they were.

interval_seconds.description: Thumbnail i shows the source at i * interval_seconds.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

job_id.description: The job making (or that made) it.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

encoding.description: One byte per peak, 255 full scale.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

author.description: Who made this revision, as they named themselves.

manifest.description: The project manifest: media, tracks and clips.

cleaned.description: Of those, clips playing a cleaned copy.

revision.description: The revision that turned it on; undo it to turn it off.

state.description: `on`: every clip on the audio tracks plays a cleaned copy.

presence.description: People in the project in the editor right now: who, their `selection` (`{start, end, clips?}`) and `playhead`. Set with POST /projects/{project}/presence.

working_on.description: What agents said they are doing right now: who, `text`, and the `clips`, `range` or `scene` they will touch. Set with POST /projects/{project}/working_on.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

render.description: A render of the current timeline at each quality your plan has.

studio_sound.description: Studio Sound on the voice files. Voices cleaned before are free.

Range.description: A stretch of the timeline. Ends are exclusive.

RenderProject.description: What to render and how. Every field is optional.

boxes.description: Cap on machines for this render (default: chosen for you).

force.description: Render even if this exact output already exists.

hedge.description: Run slow ranges again on idle machines (default true).

loudness.description: Normalize the final mix to this integrated loudness (LUFS).

range_seconds.description: Length of each render range, in seconds (default 15).

revision.description: Render this revision instead of the branch head.

split.description: `cuts` (default): ranges follow clip boundaries, so later edits reuse untouched ranges; `grid`: fixed ranges from frame 0.

resolved.description: true resolves the thread; false reopens it.

RestoreProject.description: The revision whose timeline comes back, and optionally the head you decided against (`expected_head`) and a line for history (`summary`).

author.description: Who is doing it, as history and Activity name them. Default: you.

expected_head.description: The head this was decided against; a moved head is a conflict.

revision.description: The revision whose timeline comes back.

summary.description: One line for Activity; default: says which revision came back.

restored.description: The revision whose timeline came back.

name.description: The preset's name. Saving again under a name replaces it; built-in names are taken.

SentPart.description: One sent part: its number and the `ETag` header its PUT returned.

shot.description: The shot it is tagged with.

recording.description: The recording it was part of, when the editor recorded screen and camera together.

source.description: Where the file came from, for example `{"type": "hyperframes", "project": "intro", "version": 3}`. `files` shows it, so an agent knows what to edit to change the file.

on_timeline.description: Where it is used on the timeline.

revision.description: The shot list's own revision. Send it back as `expected_revision`.

created.description: After an edit: the new scene and shot ids, in order.

expected_revision.description: The revision you read (0 for a new shot list).

operations.description: Applied in order, all or none. See [Plan with the shot list](https://docs.vidjutsu.ai/guides/shot-list#operations).

email.description: Where to send the sign-in code.

attempt.description: Send it back with the code to POST /auth/verify.

name.description: A name for the API key this creates.

api_key.description: `vj_live_...`. Shown once: keep it. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

checkout_url.description: When `status` is `no_plan`: a Stripe Checkout link to add a card and make your first payment ($5 or more).

StartUpload.description: The file's name, exact length and SHA-256.

bytes.description: The file's exact length in bytes.

name.description: File name for the media id (`take1.mov` becomes media `take1`).

sha256.description:
The file's SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex digits. The server checks the
stored bytes against it before keeping them.

project.description: The project this file is for. Its open editors show the progress.

StudioSound.description: Which voices to clean. Every field is optional.

media.description: Clean only these voices (media ids played on audio tracks). Leave it out to clean every media item the audio tracks play, music included, so name your voices when there is music.

untranscribed.description: Media on the timeline without a transcript.

amount_usd.description: Dollars, in whole cents, from 5 to 500 (for example `25` or `"12.50"`). Default 10.

success_url.description: https URL to return to after paying.

cancel_url.description: https URL to return to if you cancel.

job_id.description: The job making (or that made) it.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

UndoProject.description: The revision to undo and, optionally, one change of it (`change`, its `index` in history). Undoing the head as a whole restores its parent; anything else puts back what the change did on top of the current head, so later edits stay.

author.description: Who is doing it, as history and Activity name them. Default: you.

change.description: Which change (its `index` in `history`); absent: the whole revision.

revision.description: The revision that made the change.

already_stored.description: The hash is already stored: send no parts, just complete.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds when the part links stop working.

part_size.description: Bytes in every part but the last (the rest).

Usage.description: Your wallet balance (`credits.balance_micros`) and auto top-up setting (`credits.auto_top_up`), this month's usage of each meter (render minutes up to 1080p, render minutes above 1080p, storage), spend against your monthly limit, renders running and storage used. Money is in micro-dollars. `{"state": "unavailable"}` when it can't be read right now.

auto_top_up.description: On, threshold, amount and the last failure, or null when off.

spend.description: This period's usage spend (`used_micros`), your monthly limit (`limit_micros`) and when it resets.

Wallet.description: Money is in micro-dollars with `_usd` twins.

not_transcribed.description: Files without a transcript (make one with POST /media/{hash}/transcript).

text.description: What you are about to do, in a few words ("Cutting the pauses in scene 2"). null clears it.

scene.description: The shot list scene you are working on.
